description: Find recent ERC-20 transfers on Base, optionally filtered to transfers from or to a specific wallet. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402.

from_address.description: Optional sender wallet to filter ERC-20 transfers.

from_block.description: First Base block to include in the transfer query.

to_address.description: Optional recipient wallet to filter ERC-20 transfers.

to_block.description: Last Base block to include in the transfer query.

token.description: ERC-20 or token contract address on Base mainnet.

name: base_erc20_transfers
